mentions.name: Duckville
mentions.description: A browser-based shared-town simulation game where players are ducks: pick a job, pay rent, post on a Twitter-style feed, and vote in local elections. The simulation keeps running when the tab is closed, and the game has no PvP, loot boxes, or combat, with playtime designed to be a few minutes a day.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://duckville.town

You play a duck in a small shared town. You pick a job, pay rent, post on a Twitter-style feed, vote in local elections. The simulation keeps running when you close the tab. No PvP, no loot boxes, no combat. Playtime is a few minutes a day by design.
